Type.name: VeloxDev.WorkflowSystem.SlotChannel
Type.Text: Flags enum: each direction is evaluated independently, and per direction the priority is Multiple > One > None, the higher one overriding the lower. When a node's [SlotSelectors] includes SlotChannel, it is also valid as a SlotEnumerator selector type for routing signals by channel type.

Member.name: None
Member.Text: None: Default value indicating no connections are allowed.

Member.name: OneTarget
Member.Text: One Target: This slot may actively connect to at most 1 target, i.e. at most 1 outgoing connection.

Member.name: OneSource
Member.Text: One Source: This slot may be connected by at most 1 source, i.e. at most 1 incoming connection.

Member.name: OneBoth
Member.Text: One Both: Equivalent to OneTarget | OneSource. It means at most 1 outgoing connection and at most 1 incoming connection, counted independently. It does not mean a strict one-to-one pairing with the same peer.

Member.name: MultipleTargets
Member.Text: Multiple Targets: This slot may actively connect to multiple targets, i.e. multiple outgoing connections are allowed.

Member.name: MultipleSources
Member.Text: Multiple Sources: This slot may be connected by multiple sources, i.e. multiple incoming connections are allowed.

Member.name: MultipleBoth
Member.Text: Multiple Both: Equivalent to MultipleTargets | MultipleSources. It means both outgoing and incoming directions allow multiple connections, counted independently.

Type.Text: Compile-time identity context: fixed Order / in-chain index ChainIndex / sub-graph Offset

Member.name: InputNodes
Member.Text: Join-point input source nodes: when Count > 1 the runtime aggregates each upstream output into a read-only GroupData dictionary injected as Data; null on chained/single-input nodes

Type.name: VeloxDev.Core.WorkflowSystem.CompilerEx.RouterCompileMode
Type.Text: The router's compile mode: Static returns only the currently selected branch at compile time, so the compiled graph holds that single path with its order fixed; Dynamic returns every branch at compile time, so the compiled graph keeps the whole branch structure and the key is resolved at run time.

Type.name: VeloxDev.Core.WorkflowSystem.CompilerEx.IRuntimeContext
Type.Text: Compiler runtime session context: UID/logs/shared variables/execution position, passed to nodes as the task context during compiled runs

Member.name: ActiveRedirectTarget
Member.Text: Active redirect target Order set by the engine at the start of each pass (null on the first pass); the output collector uses it to distinguish contract-preserved prefix from stale branches

Member.name: RegisterOutput
Member.Text: Register a node's output for this run stamped with the current attempt: the engine writes it after driving each node, and multi-input joins aggregate per input group

Member.name: ResetOutputs
Member.Text: Clear the product registry once at the start of each RunAsync (not cleared on redirect re-runs; stale outputs are filtered by pass stamp)

Member.name: CollectGroupedInputs
Member.Text: Collect outputs for a group of input nodes as IGroupData: only this pass's outputs plus the contract-preserved prefix before the redirect target; unregistered sources are absent

Type.name: VeloxDev.Core.WorkflowSystem.CompilerEx.IGroupData
Type.Text: Group data: multi-input join reads each upstream node's output as a read-only dictionary (Key=source node reference, Value=its output this run)
